attach.col.name: Name
attach.edit.title: Attachment
attach.options.title: Attachments pane options
audit.hint: The file takes {size}. Sizes are approximate: content is counted as it is stored in the file.
audit.title: Space usage
barcode.caption: Write the content below the bars
barcode.hint.any: Any text: a web address, for example.
barcode.hint.ascii: Letters, digits and signs without accents.
barcode.hint.codabar: Digits and - $ : / . + between a start and a stop letter from A to D (A1234B, for example).
barcode.hint.digits: Digits only (the check digit is added when it is left out).
barcode.title: Add Barcode
compare.hint: The text is compared word by word; changes are highlighted in both documents.
compare.none: Compare two documents to see what changed
compare.title: Compare documents
contents.at_start: At the start of the document
contents.headings_hint: Lines set clearly larger than the text are taken as headings (running heads left out); the largest are the first level. Each becomes a bookmark that opens its page at the heading. Click a heading to see it.
contents.hint: Pages listing the bookmarks, indented by level, with the numbers the pages have once these are in; every entry is a link to its place.
contents.no_bookmarks: The document has no bookmarks to list.
contents.no_headings: No headings were found: no line is set clearly larger than the text.
contents.replace: In place of the bookmarks there are
contents.title: Title
explorer.delete.body: The {count} selected files and folders go to the recycle bin, where they can be restored.
explorer.delete.body_one: The selected item goes to the recycle bin, where it can be restored.
explorer.delete.title: Move to the recycle bin?
explorer.empty: Nothing in this folder matches the filter.
grey.hint: One undo step. View › Grey Preview shows the pages in grey without changing them.
grey.kept.content: page content that cannot be read
grey.kept.inline-picture: pictures inline in the page content
grey.nothing: Nothing to convert: the document is already grey.
grey.title: Convert Colours to Grey
grey.will: Will become grey — colours of the pages and drawings: {colours}; pictures: {pictures}; comments and fields: {comments}.
inserttext.hint: New pages with this text follow the current page. A form feed starts a new page.
inserttext.title: Insert text
layers.choose.comments_hint: The selected comments, their replies and pop-up notes move to this layer: hiding the layer hides them.
layers.choose.drawing: What I draw or write next
layers.choose.drawing_hint: Comments, pictures and barcodes you add from now on belong to this layer. It is a choice of this window, not saved in the document.
layers.drawing_here: New drawings and text go to this layer (click to stop)
layers.import.title: Import as layer
layers.merge.hint: Their content, comments and images move to the chosen layer; their sublayers move up.
layers.merge.title: Merge layers
layers.move.comments: {count} comments move to the new layer, with their replies and pop-up notes.
layers.move.comments_one: {count} comment moves to the new layer, with its replies and pop-up note.
layers.move.picture: The selected picture moves to the new layer.
layers.move.picture_hint: Only a picture the page draws itself can move (not one inside a reused drawing).
layers.name: Name
layers.options.hint: When parents override their children, hiding a layer also hides the layers below it.
layers.options.title: Layers pane options
layers.override.hint: Changes only the view; the document keeps its default visibility until you make the view the default.
layers.override.title: Layer visibility
layers.view_differs: The view shows or hides layers differently from the document.
macro.guide.hint: Macros are replaced in watermarks, headers and footers, page numbers and Bates numbers. Write them in braces; the value column shows them for the current page.
macro.guide.title: Macros
macro.launch.x: left edge of the view on the page, points
macro.launch.xpx: left edge of the view on the page, pixels
macro.launch.y: top edge of the view on the page, points
macro.launch.ypx: top edge of the view on the page, pixels
media.none: The document has no sound or video comments.
media.title: Title
meta.no_templates: No templates yet: keep the information of a document as a template to give it to others.
meta.no_xmp: The document has no XMP metadata; Save XMP writes one made from its information.
meta.template_hint: The title, author, subject and keywords of the document are kept. Empty fields of a template leave the document's own.
meta.title: Metadata templates
multiplace.hint: The selected signature is copied at the same spot on the pages chosen.
multiplace.title: Place the signature on several pages
ocr.hint: The text is read with the model of the Latin script (English, Italian, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese and 26 more languages) and written invisibly over the pages, so they can be searched and their text selected and copied.
ocr.hint_pictures: Only the text inside the pictures of the pages is read, and written invisibly over them.
ocr.no_models: The text recognition models were not found: they belong in the ocr folder next to the program.
ocr.review_hint: Write the word as the picture shows it and press Enter. Keep leaves it as it was read; Remove takes away a word that is not text (a speck, a line).
ocr.review_none: There are no doubtful words to check: the recognized text of this document is checked.
ocr.review_skipped: The words skipped are still doubtful: Review Recognized Text shows them again.
ocr.skip_text: Leave out pages that already have text
ocr.write_hint: Write on the Page adds the text invisibly over the area, so it can be searched and selected.
office.breaks: Begin each page on a new page
office.hint: The text is exported in reading order as editable paragraphs and headings; pictures and comments are not exported yet. The document itself is never written.
office.title: Export to Office Formats
picture.apply_all_hint: With Apply to All a picture drawn in several places changes everywhere; otherwise only the selected one changes.
picture.crop_hint: drag over the picture, then choose Crop again or double click
picture.external_hint: The picture is open in another app. Save it there, then choose Update to put it on the page.
picture.external_saved: Saved in the other app: ready to update.
picture.external_waiting: Not saved in the other app yet.
portfolio.cover_hint: This document is a portfolio: its pages are the cover of the files it holds.
portfolio.preview_none: Select a file to preview it
preflight.fixable: {count} problems, all of which conversion fixes.
preflight.hint: The rules listed are checked; what they do not cover is not. Conversion fixes what it can in a copy, opened in a new tab, and declares PDF/A-2b only when no rule is left broken.
preflight.not_fixable: {count} problems; some cannot be fixed by conversion, so the copy will not be declared PDF/A.
preflight.not_fixable_one: 1 problem that conversion cannot fix: the copy will not be declared PDF/A.
preflight.rule.annotation-appearance: Annotations with a normal appearance only
preflight.rule.metadata-sync: Metadata agree with the document information
preflight.title: Preflight
read.no_text: There is no text to read here: pages that are pictures need text recognition first (OCR Pages).
read.no_voice: No voice of the system is available for reading aloud.
read.no_voice_linux: No voice is available: reading aloud on Linux uses speech-dispatcher, which needs to be installed with a voice (for example espeak-ng).
read.play: Read from the current page (or the text selected)
read.ready: Reads from the current page, or the text selected.
recompress.hint: Colour and grey pictures become JPEG when that makes them smaller, scaled down where they are drawn at more than the resolution chosen; transparent pictures and masks are kept, and a picture is never replaced by a larger one.
recompress.title: Recompress pictures
reflow.no_text: These pages have no text to show: pages that are pictures need text recognition first (OCR Pages).
reflow.title: Reflow: the text of the document, in the width of the window
scan.asking: Asking the scanner what it offers…
scan.backs: Then scan the backs of the sheets as a second stack
scan.clean_up: Clean up the scanned pages afterwards
scan.none: No scanner was found. Check that it is switched on and connected, and that SANE (scanimage) is installed.
scan.reversed: The stack is turned over (last sheet first)
scan.system_dialog: The system's scanning window opens: choose the scanner and how to scan there.
scan.turn_over: {count} fronts scanned. Turn the stack over and scan the backs.
scan.turn_over_one: 1 front scanned. Turn it over and scan its back.
scan.unavailable: Scanning is not available on this system yet.
scans.blank_below: Blank below this share of ink (%)
scans.changed: The document has changed since its pages were looked at.
scans.clean: Nothing to clean up with these thresholds.
scans.hint: The pages that are a picture of paper are looked at: blank sides are taken out and sheets fed askew are straightened, in one step that Undo takes back. Click a page to see it.
scans.none: No page is a scan (a picture covering the page).
sequence.info.author: Author
sequence.info.title: Title
sequence.no_steps: No steps yet: add one below.
sequence.title: Action Sequences
sources.empty: Add PDF files, pictures or text files: their pages make the new document, in this order.
sources.hint: Ctrl+click selects several files; type the pages to take, such as 1-3, 5.
split.no_lines: Add lines where the pages are cut, or make a grid below.
split.parts: Each page cut becomes {count} pages, in reading order. Drag a line to move it.
split.parts_one: Each page stays one page. Draw a line to cut it.
templates.hint.cornell: A column for cues, lines for notes, a box for the summary.
templates.hint.handwriting: Four lines for each row of writing.
templates.hint.invoice: A form that works out the amounts, the subtotal and the total.
templates.hint.letter: Fields for the sender, the recipient, the date, the subject and the text.
templates.hint.meeting: Fields for the date, who came, the agenda, the notes, the decisions and the actions.
templates.hint.month: A month on each page, its days in the right columns.
templates.hint.ruled: Lines 8 mm apart with a margin line.
templates.hint.todo: Boxes to tick and lines to fill in.
templates.hint.week: The seven days and a box for notes.
templates.mine.about: Made from {origin} on {day} with Folitecta {version}, pages: {pages}. A new document from it is a copy: the template stays as it is.
templates.mine.fonts: It uses fonts it does not carry, which the computer must have: {list}.
templates.mine.name: Name of the template
templates.mine.remove: Move the template to the bin
templates.name_used: There is already a template called “{name}”: choose another name, or rename or remove that one in the gallery.
templates.save_hint: The template keeps the pages, fields and comments as they are now. It is listed under My templates in File › New › From Template….
templates.word.subject: Subject
